This automated charging system is used at the maintenance facility, where six charging positions are served by a single 38-kilowatts direct current (kW ) power supply. A 120-kW fast charge station is also located at one of the DC DC Rivium station berths, allowing a vehicle stopped at that berth to receive a partial recharge of its batteries during an extended dwell with a fully automated process. 3.2.4 Jacksonville U2C The Jacksonville Transportation Authority (JTA) launched the first phase of its multiphase program, the Ultimate Urban Circulator, in June 2025. JTA committed the funding and initiated the design tasks necessary for the launch of what will evolve into a public transit system that is prototypical of an AMD. The first two editions of the AMD implementation catalog reported on the progressive, multiphase implementation plan that JTA now has underway.
